picks.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
picks.take: Anthropic warns it is close to AI that builds itself, which in clinical terms is a company announcing a dramatic acceleration while also filing for an IPO. Informed consent has never been so well timed.

picks.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
picks.take: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model nobody can use yet. Like many promising therapies, it is wildly effective in the press release and still awaiting enrollment.

picks.title: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
picks.take: Wired found about 400 apps posing as ordinary AI tools while hiding abusive deepfake features. Apparently the app store review process screens as thoroughly as a pre-op checklist filled out by the vending machine.

picks.title: How a Contractor’s Claude Agent Got Into the Pentagon
picks.take: A contractor's Claude agent reportedly reached the Pentagon, a reminder that access controls are only as strong as whoever delegated them to a chatbot. Healthcare IT, we see you nodding and also sweating.

picks.title: Announcing Project ProtoStar: Making Publicly Funded Science AI-Ready
picks.take: Hugging Face wants publicly funded science to be AI-ready. Fine, but first perhaps make it PDF-readable, reproducible, and not hidden behind a paywall the taxpayer already bought once.

picks.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
picks.take: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as protection for nearby communities, offering up to 1,000 megawatts during emergencies. A rare case where the side effect is marketed as the indication.

picks.title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
picks.take: The New York Times and other publishers sue Brave over alleged AI scraping and paywall bypassing. The newsroom's business model is now in the differential, alongside the rest of the content economy.

picks.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
picks.take: OpenAI updates its Model Spec around five core values, including human agency and faithfulness to intent. Every medical school has a similar document, and we all know how closely residents follow the mission statement at 3 a.m.

picks.title: Credit Saison achieves 954% ROI in a ChatGPT Enterprise pilot
picks.take: Credit Saison reports 954% ROI from a ChatGPT Enterprise pilot. In medicine we would ask for the confidence interval, the control group, and who exactly counted the hours saved.

picks.title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
picks.take: Musk throttles Grok Bot limits because costs are 'unsustainably high,' mere days after touting record growth. Turns out that growth is great until someone has to pay for the dose.
